subtopics.title: Creating Evaluation Guidelines
subtopics.summary: Defining evaluation criteria and creating scoring rubrics with examples to establish clear standards for assessing system outputs.

subtopics.title: Evaluating All System Components
subtopics.summary: Assessing each component of an AI system individually, including domain-specific capability, generation capability, instruction-following capability, cost, and latency.

subtopics.title: Defining Evaluation Methods and Data
subtopics.summary: Selecting appropriate evaluation methods, annotating evaluation data, and curating test sets that reflect production scenarios including edge cases and out-of-scope inputs.

subtopics.title: Tying Metrics to Business Metrics
subtopics.summary: Connecting evaluation metrics to business outcomes to ensure that technical performance aligns with organizational goals and user needs.

subtopics.title: Evaluating and Iterating the Pipeline
subtopics.summary: Assessing the reliability of the evaluation pipeline itself and iterating on guidelines, methods, and data based on findings to improve evaluation quality over time.
